Joey's Workshop

Hi, I’m Joey and I’m a live coder, musician and creative technologist. I made this website to share some useful information for my workshop.

Sometimes I’m also known as Zhou Yuyang. And for the performance I usually go by JoeyJoeyJoe (I’m seriously considering changing my stage name). I use code (sometimes synthesiser) to make music and visual. Check out one of the music I made ⬇️


You can also find some clips of my performance on my Instagram or YouTube (it’s still catching up with Instagram)

And now, I’m producing my first EP!
